integrity: All algebraic claims are proved using explicit matrix identities; finite checks supplement, not replace, the arguments. No external independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a commuting two-dimensional nilpotent noise/drift pair and the drift-implicit theta-Maruyama update only. One-step Euclidean mean-square contraction differs from asymptotic stability and from integration accuracy. Historical priority is not independently settled; a highly relevant scalar 2000 text was not available in full.
title: A sharp contractivity phase diagram and two-step extinction for nilpotent-noise stochastic theta integration
